config.serverPath.description: Path to the codeatlas executable. If empty, the bundled server/ is used first, then PATH.
config.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI narration (local or online): one paragraph with fact citations for each container / component / entry flow. When off, the server starts with --no-ai and the narration card shows "AI disabled". The server restarts automatically after changes.
config.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Protocol of the AI service. Use the command **CodeTrail Graph: Select AI Service** to set protocol, endpoint and model in one go.
config.ai.provider.enum0: OpenAI-compatible protocol (local llama-server, DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenAI, etc.)
config.ai.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of the AI service API (up to `/v1`), e.g. local llama-server `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1` or DeepSeek `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`. When it is not a loopback address, the narration card shows a prominent warning: the fact subgraph (and entry source code when `includeSource` is on) is sent there. Store the API key with the command **CodeTrail Graph: Set AI API Key** (kept in SecretStorage, not here).
config.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model name sent in requests, e.g. `qwen3.6-27b`, `deepseek-chat`, `qwen-plus`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`. The cache is keyed by "subgraph hash + model name", so switching models recomputes narrations.
config.ai.concurrency.description: Number of narrations generated at the same time. Online services can use 2–4; keep 1 for local models (concurrency only slows them down).
config.ai.timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout per narration (seconds). Local 27B models are slow, keep 300; 60 is enough for online services.
config.ai.includeSource.description: When generating an entry flow narration, also send the entry method source (≤80 lines) to the model. When off, only the fact subgraph (names, edges, config keys, call tree) is sent.
config.projects.markdownDescription: Other project directories to index together with the current workspace (relative to the first workspace folder, or absolute), e.g. a backend `../shop-api` next to a frontend repo. In a multi-root workspace, folders other than the first are added automatically and need not be listed here. Files in external directories are stored with relative paths like `../shop-api/…`, so frontend calls can link to backend controllers. Can also be set in the repo's `.codeatlas/config.json`: `{"projects": ["../other-repo"]}`. The server restarts and runs an incremental index after changes.
config.includeNestedRepos.markdownDescri: Index nested repositories with their own `.git` directory (separate clones) and submodules inside the workspace. When off they are skipped entirely (the server starts with `--no-nested`). Git worktrees (where `.git` is a file pointing to `…/worktrees/…`, e.g. `.claude/worktrees/*`) are always skipped to avoid duplicates. The server restarts and runs an incremental index after changes.
config.indexOnSave.description: Run an incremental index automatically after saving a supported source file.
config.indexOnExternalChange.markdownDes: Watch for source file changes made outside the editor (AI coding assistants writing to disk, `git pull` / branch switches, code generators) and run one incremental index after they settle. Independent of `#codeatlas.indexOnSave#`: files saved in the editor are always handled by that setting and never trigger a second index. Only applies to folders whose CodeTrail Graph server is already running in this session; changes made while the server is not running are reconciled when it starts.
config.externalChangeDebounceMs.markdown: Quiet period (milliseconds) after the last outside-the-editor change before the incremental index runs; a branch switch touching thousands of files becomes a single request. Minimum 200.
config.codeLens.enabled.markdownDescript: Show a CodeLens above every method / function / constructor: `entry · N callers · K tests · calls M · Impact`; click to list callers / callees and jump. Only shown for folders where CodeTrail Graph was used this session or that already have `.codeatlas/index.db`; it never creates an index by itself.
